Save the charts from an analysis plan as files

Source: R/figures.R
sframe_save_figures.Rd

Writes each chart run_analysis_plan() drew with plots = TRUE to its own file, at the size, resolution and format a journal asks for. The charts the exported sframe_plot_*() functions return are ggplot objects, so any one of them can also be saved at any size with ggplot2::ggsave().

Usage

sframe_save_figures(
  results,
  dir,
  width = 7,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 300,
  format = c("png", "tiff", "jpeg", "pdf", "svg")
)

Arguments

results

The list run_analysis_plan() returns, run with plots = TRUE.

dir

Directory to write into. Created when absent.

width, height

Size in inches. Default 7 by 4.5.

dpi

Resolution in dots per inch, for the raster formats. Default 300.

format

One of "png" (default), "tiff", "jpeg", "pdf" or "svg".

Value

The paths written, named by block id, invisibly. Only blocks that drew a chart write a file.

See also

render_report(), which takes the same settings as figures.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  d <- sframe_demo("two_group")
  res <- run_analysis_plan(d$responses, d$instrument, plots = TRUE)
  paths <- sframe_save_figures(res, file.path(tempdir(), "figures"),
                               width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  basename(paths)
}
#> [1] "RQ1.png" "RQ2.png"
# }
